title: Pixel Launcher New Build- V0.0140
author: TalkingPixelsStudio
selftext:
![img](euj34f19zbwh1 "Download Here: https://talkingpixels.games/pixel-launcher")

Worked on this with my dev platform for a long while but wanted to share it where I think it could be of use. Let me know if ya have any feedback or questions. Have fun creating all

The Hall has a little more life: aqua and void portal animations from Rift Keepers, with an Animated launcher effects toggle when you want things quiet.

Also in this update:  
• Game Updates with version numbers and patch notes. Start download now or Wait for later.  
• Update safeguards while games are running or another install is busy.  
• Cleaner platform-style buttons and larger touch targets.  
• Collapsible Menu, Friends and Home news panels that remember your choices.  
• Controller focus, high contrast and reduced-motion support retained.

[Pixel Launcher · Talking Pixels](https://talkingpixels.games/@talkingpixels/pixel-launcher)

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: You need to work on the art style and UI. It all just screams generic AI.

replies.author: TalkingPixelsStudio
replies.body: I used some simple things for borders and such but I’m working on the final design. There’s also tools to skin/theme it and share it/upload it but I haven’t had feedback on it yet

replies.author: Three_Tails_Studio
replies.body: Feedback is fix your spelling errors and make this look less horrible
